steps.content:
The analysis is conclusive. The account's cost on 2025-10-13 was elevated (~$10,316 vs. the ~$10,100 Monday baseline), and the root cause is a single resource:

- **GCP / cloud_service `nOcDI` / application `eTs` / instance_family `qtVJ1PKHrR`**: its `num_instances` jumped from the usual 7–10 (and price stayed constant at $0.3911) to **35 instances** starting 10/13, driving its daily cost from ~$75 to $328.52 — a +$251.55 delta that explains essentially the entire anomaly (z-score ≈ 26, while every other resource is within normal variation).

Per the naming convention (resource name = value in `instance_family`, type = that column title-cased), the root cause is:

<answer>
{"resource": [{"name": "qtVJ1PKHrR", "type": "Instance Family"}]}
</answer>

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu']

# Baseline: for each resource, mean cost on prior Mondays (09/08, 09/15, 09/22, 09/29, 10/06)
r = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
mondays = ['09/08/2025','09/15/2025','09/22/2025','09/29/2025','10/06/2025']
base = acc[acc.date.isin(mondays)].groupby(r).unblended_cost.mean()
d13 = acc[acc.date=='10/13/2025'].groupby(r).unblended_cost.sum()
comp = pd.concat([base, d13], axis=1).fillna(0)
comp.columns = ['baseline','c13']
comp['diff'] = comp.c13 - comp.baseline
print(comp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(10))
print("total diff:", comp.diff.sum())
"}

function.arguments:
{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu']
r = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
d13 = acc[acc.date=='10/13/2025'].groupby(r).unblended_cost.sum()
# baseline: all dates except 10/13-15, per day of week
acc2 = acc[~acc.date.isin(['10/13/2025','10/14/2025','10/15/2025'])].copy()
acc2['dow'] = pd.to_datetime(acc2.date, format='%m/%d/%Y').dt.dayofweek
base = acc2[acc2.dow==0].groupby(r).unblended_cost.mean()
comp = pd.concat([base, d13], axis=1).fillna(0)
comp.columns=['baseline','c13']
comp['diff']=comp.c13-comp.baseline
print("total diff:", comp.diff.sum())
print(comp.sort_values('diff',ascending=False).head(5))
# z-score approach: per resource, mean & std over all 42 prior days
piv = acc[~acc.date.isin(['10/13/2025','10/14/2025','10/15/2025'])].groupby(r).unblended_cost.agg(['mean','std'])
piv['z'] = (d13 - piv.mean)/piv.std
print(piv.sort_values('z',ascending=False).head(5))
"}
